name: THE BARBER-DENTIST-SURGEON
note: Doc 07 #9: 'His shop. One man, three trades, one set of instruments. Period-accurate.' His tree and his barks are doc 07's, extracted; doc 105's Overrides answer the room's wrong verbs. Present in every act.
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: beside him at his own depth, on the door's side, clear of him and of the chair (doc 55 section 8: beside them at their own depth).

barks.R_SWINDLED: Shave? You've the face of a man who's been had.
barks.R_RACCOON: If it bites you, come straight here. Don't wait.
barks.R_BORDERS_MOTT: Free shave, Mr. Grubb! First one's free!
barks.R_LOST_DUEL: Nothing I can do about pride.
barks.R_DEAD: I'd have done the laying-out at a fair price. Nobody asked me.
